overview: A mobile-first apparel e-commerce store where shoppers browse clothing by category, filter by size/color/price, add items to cart, and complete purchases via Stripe. Includes optional user accounts with order history and saved addresses.
features: Product catalog with categories (Men, Women, Kids, Accessories)
Search and filtering by size, color, price range
Product detail pages with image gallery and variant selection
Guest checkout with optional account creation
User accounts with order history and saved addresses
